LESSON: PREVENTION OF PARASITES HYGIENE

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Prevention of parasites hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Prevention of parasites hygiene. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: where like?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify common external parasite found on the body,
2. name common internal parasites found in the body,
3. identify common internal parasites found in the body, pictures, video clips and charts 202 e) mention the causes of external and internal parasites in the body, f) mention the effects of parasite infestation to the body, g) state the importance of effects of parasite infestation (illness, personal cleanliness in preventing internal and external parasites, h) practice personal cleanliness to prevent parasite infestation. cleanliness can help prevent parasite infestation in and out of the body video clips on good practices of personal cleanliness to prevent parasite infestation. using computing devices. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS
